theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℕ) (L : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → |L g| ≤ M) → ∃ (μ₀ : Measure X) (ν : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn ν K μ₀) ∧ ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), L g = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ₀
